meaning: size; height or build (of a person or thing)

senses.en: size; height or build (of a person or thing)

note: Colloquial, Northern; 个子 is the more common word for a person's height.

examples.zh: 他个儿很高，打篮球很合适。
examples.en: He is tall, so he's well suited to basketball.

examples.zh: 这个西瓜个儿真大！
examples.en: This watermelon is really big!

examples.zh: 那个个儿小的孩子是谁？
examples.en: Who is that small child?

meaning: to feel pained for someone; to hate to see something wasted

senses.en: to feel pained for someone; to hate to see something wasted

note: Two uses: sympathy for a person, or regret over losing money or things.

examples.zh: 看孩子生病，妈妈很心疼。
examples.en: Seeing the child sick, his mother feels heartbroken.

examples.zh: 这么贵的包被弄坏了，我真心疼。
examples.en: Such an expensive bag got ruined; it really pains me.

examples.zh: 你工作太辛苦了，我心疼你。
examples.en: You work so hard that it hurts me to see it.

meaning: to advocate; to promote (an idea or practice)

senses.en: to advocate; to promote (an idea or practice)

note: Formal; the subject is usually an organization or public figure.

examples.zh: 学校倡导大家少用纸。
examples.en: The school encourages everyone to use less paper.

examples.zh: 医生倡导健康的生活方式。
examples.en: Doctors advocate a healthy lifestyle.

examples.zh: 我们公司倡导少开会、多做事。
examples.en: Our company advocates fewer meetings and more getting things done.

examples.zh: 这条路的宽度是多少？
examples.en: How wide is this road?

examples.zh: 请量一下桌子的宽度。
examples.en: Please measure the width of the table.

examples.zh: 这扇门的宽度不够，沙发进不去。
examples.en: This door isn't wide enough for the sofa to go in.

meaning: to restrict or constrain; a constraint

senses.en: to restrict or constrain; a constraint

note: Formal; used for factors that limit something, often 互相制约.

examples.zh: 资金不够制约了公司的发展。
examples.en: Not enough funding limits the company's growth.

examples.zh: 天气制约着我们的旅行计划。
examples.en: The weather constrains our travel plans.

examples.zh: 这两件事互相制约。
examples.en: These two things constrain each other.

examples.zh: 老师给了我们一份考试大纲。
examples.en: The teacher gave us an exam syllabus.

examples.zh: 写论文以前，先列个大纲吧。
examples.en: Before writing the paper, make an outline first.

examples.zh: 你看过这门课的大纲吗？
examples.en: Have you seen the syllabus for this course?

examples.zh: 我爸爸喜欢听相声。
examples.en: My dad likes listening to crosstalk.

examples.zh: 周末我们去看相声吧。
examples.en: Let's go see a crosstalk show this weekend.

examples.zh: 这段相声太有意思了。
examples.en: This crosstalk routine is so funny.

examples.zh: 天气太热，我买了一把扇子。
examples.en: It's so hot that I bought a fan.

examples.zh: 你能把那把扇子递给我吗？
examples.en: Could you hand me that fan?

examples.zh: 这把扇子上画着花。
examples.en: There are flowers painted on this fan.

examples.zh: 我们下班后去打羽毛球吧。
examples.en: Let's play badminton after work.

examples.zh: 他羽毛球打得很好。
examples.en: He plays badminton very well.

examples.zh: 这个羽毛球坏了，再买一个吧。
examples.en: This shuttlecock is broken; let's buy another one.

examples.zh: 中午太忙，我就订了一份盒饭。
examples.en: I was too busy at noon, so I just ordered a boxed meal.

examples.zh: 这家的盒饭又便宜又好吃。
examples.en: The boxed meals here are both cheap and tasty.

examples.zh: 火车上有卖盒饭的吗？
examples.en: Is there anyone selling boxed meals on the train?

note: Often 文艺演出 (performance) or 文艺活动.

examples.zh: 学校下周有一场文艺演出。
examples.en: The school has an arts performance next week.

examples.zh: 她从小就喜欢文艺，又会唱歌又会跳舞。
examples.en: She has loved the arts since childhood and can both sing and dance.

examples.zh: 周末他常去参加文艺活动。
examples.en: On weekends he often goes to arts events.

examples.zh: 这所学校今年在全国招生。
examples.en: This school is enrolling students nationwide this year.

examples.zh: 大学的招生通知什么时候出来？
examples.en: When will the university's admissions notice come out?

examples.zh: 这个班还招生吗？
examples.en: Is this class still taking new students?

examples.zh: 这两个盒子的重量相等。
examples.en: These two boxes weigh the same.

examples.zh: 这两个数相等吗？
examples.en: Are these two numbers equal?

examples.zh: 两个方案的价格相等，你选哪个？
examples.en: The two plans cost the same; which one do you choose?

meaning: function; role (of an organization or position)

senses.en: function; role (of an organization or position)

note: Formal; used for departments, institutions and offices.

examples.zh: 这个部门的职能是什么？
examples.en: What is the function of this department?

examples.zh: 学校的主要职能是教育学生。
examples.en: The main role of a school is to educate students.

examples.zh: 各部门要明确自己的职能。
examples.en: Each department must be clear about its own role.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅价格实惠，菜也很多。
examples.en: This restaurant is good value, and the portions are generous.

examples.zh: 买大包装更实惠。
examples.en: Buying the large pack is better value.

examples.zh: 这个套餐看起来很实惠。
examples.en: This set meal looks like good value.

examples.zh: 春天，公园里的桃花开了。
examples.en: In spring, the peach blossoms in the park are out.

examples.zh: 我们周末去看桃花吧。
examples.en: Let's go see the peach blossoms this weekend.

examples.zh: 她的脸红得像桃花一样。
examples.en: Her face was as pink as peach blossoms.

note: Formal; also the person or party that does something, as in 学习的主体.

examples.zh: 这座大楼的主体已经建好了。
examples.en: The main structure of this building is already finished.

examples.zh: 学生是学习的主体，老师只是帮助他们。
examples.en: Students are the main actors in learning; teachers just help them.

examples.zh: 这个项目的主体部分下周完成。
examples.en: The main part of this project will be done next week.

examples.zh: 我的鼠标坏了，点不了。
examples.en: My mouse is broken, so I can't click.

examples.zh: 请用鼠标点一下这里。
examples.en: Please click here with the mouse.

examples.zh: 这个鼠标用起来很方便。
examples.en: This mouse is very convenient to use.

meaning: to take as an elective; an elective course

senses.en: to take as an elective; an elective course

examples.zh: 我下学期想选修一门中文课。
examples.en: Next semester I want to take a Chinese course as an elective.

examples.zh: 这门课是选修课吗？
examples.en: Is this an elective course?

examples.zh: 他选修了历史课。
examples.en: He took a history course as an elective.

meaning: shortly before the New Year; before the year ends

senses.en: shortly before the New Year; before the year ends

note: Not "years ago" (that is 几年前). Here 年 = New Year/year end.

examples.zh: 年前我要把工作做完。
examples.en: I need to finish my work before the New Year.

examples.zh: 你年前能回老家吗？
examples.en: Can you get back to your hometown before the New Year?

examples.zh: 年前的火车票很难买。
examples.en: Train tickets for the days before the New Year are hard to buy.
